title.zh: 将苏禄省坦杜巴斯市镇萨帕-萨帕村学校的名称变更为Tuan Ligaddung Lipae村学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Sapa-Sapa Barrio School in the Municipality of Tandu Bas, Province of Sulu, to Tuan Ligaddung Lipae Barrio School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Sapa-Sapa Barrio School in the Municipality of Tandu Bas, Province of Sulu, to Tuan Ligaddung Lipae Barrio School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Sapa-Sapa Barrio School tại Thị trấn Tandu Bas, Tỉnh Sulu thành Tuan Ligaddung Lipae Barrio School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Sapa-Sapa Barrio School ในเทศบาล Tandu Bas, จังหวัด Sulu เป็น Tuan Ligaddung Lipae Barrio School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sapa-Sapa Barrio School di Kotamadya Tandu Bas, Provinsi Sulu menjadi Tuan Ligaddung Lipae Barrio School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sapa-Sapa Barrio School di Perbandaran Tandu Bas, Wilayah Sulu menjadi Tuan Ligaddung Lipae Barrio School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3715_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Sapa-Sapa Barrio School in the Municipality of Tandu Bas, Province of Sulu, is hereby changed to Tuan Ligaddung Lipae Barrio School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1963.
